provisional_claims.summary: engine.season() was offset by one season: day 0 reported Highsummer instead of Dawn (GROWING.md: day zero is the first day of Dawn). Fixed to SEASONS[(day//12)%4]. Also weather_on wetness used the same shifted index, so Highsummer was not the driest season. Fixed to (day//12)%4.
provisional_claims.reproduction: from mosslight.engine import season; season(0) -> 'Highsummer' (expected 'Dawn'); season(12) -> 'Ember' (expected Highsummer)

provisional_claims.summary: Campaigns: (1) runtime.execution_version ignored the campaign's recorded release and always ran conservation-2; now uses definition["runtime"]["id"]. (2) publish accepted stale workers (generation = ? OR owner != ?) → requires matching generation AND owner. (3) publish committed branch progress before writing its checkpoint (non-atomic) → single transaction. (4) fork re-applied care already performed at the checkpoint offset (offset <= event) → only strictly later events. (5) compact computed descendant-origin protection but never used it → protected checkpoints kept.
provisional_claims.reproduction: Create classic-1 campaign with a rain_barrel treatment; results differ from experiments.experiment because conservation-2 barrel rule was applied. Fork at offset k of a branch with an event at k → event executed twice. compact(parent) deleted the lineage checkpoint of an existing fork → provenance(child) raises 'Checkpoint is unavailable'. Stale claim (expired lease, reclaimed by another worker) could still publish.

provisional_claims.summary: Care plans never advance: run_plans kept a stale reference to the plan entry after tend_many replaced world.__dict__ (new workbench), so remaining/day/status updates were lost; a repeating plan stayed pending on a past day forever. Fixed by re-finding the entry after tend_many.
provisional_claims.reproduction: create(34); schedule(name, day=2, tiles=[[0,0]], action='water', repeat=3, runs=3); step(world,5) -> plan still day 2 remaining 3 (expected day 8 remaining 1, matching examples/lantern-hollow.json via hollow-actions replay).

provisional_claims.summary: Engine: strained-plant nutrient return used the previous day's vitality (before.vitality < 25) instead of the day's updated vitality, so struggling plants returned nutrients a day late. Now uses cell.vitality; create(34,16,11)+step(24) reproduces examples/first-garden.json exactly (previously two clover tiles were 2 nutrients short).
provisional_claims.reproduction: w=create(34,16,11); step(w,24); compare cells with examples/first-garden.json -> tiles 51 and 64 nutrients 33/27 vs 35/29.

provisional_claims.summary: History: (1) replay checkpoint cache key used only the last event (events[-1:]) so corrected histories reused stale cached results → key covers the full event prefix. (2) resolved commands used the authoring-time local ID binding instead of the logical reference's current ID, breaking references after corrections renumber objects. (3) cherry-pick deduplicated by command content, merging independently authored identical actions → identity is the event id. (4) rebase order check ignored the local branch's authored order → checks both local and target. (5) rebase used the parent's current head instead of the fork's recorded base_revision. (6) correct canonicalized numeric IDs in replacements against the final garden instead of the garden at that point in history.
provisional_claims.reproduction: create; append note A (id1), note B (id2), edit_note ident=2; correct {e1: null} → before fix result still showed note A (stale cache) / conflict 'No notes entry with id 2'; after fix notes=[(1,'B2')]. Correct a delete_entry(ident=1) into edit_note ident=1 → previously 'No live object has that local ID'. Cherry-pick a 'water 0,0' event into a branch that independently has 'water 0,0' → previously dropped.

provisional_claims.summary: Ensembles: (1) report() replaced the archived revision's result with current outcomes, so published reports for earlier revisions changed after edits → returns archived envelope unchanged. (2) publish validated only the ticket's previously-known reads, so a trial computed from inputs edited concurrently (first computation, empty reads) was accepted as current → validates the computation's actual reads against current input digests. (3) summarize paired every control in dict order with the treatment rows of paired replicates (misaligned when a replicate is excluded) → pairs by replicate label. (4) evaluate on cache hit reported the cached trial's identity (another replicate with an equal save) → identity is always the requested replicate/treatment.
provisional_claims.reproduction: Create examples/ensemble.json, work to completion, report(rev0); edit plan:water, work, then report(eid, 0) returned rev1 results. Add a source 'copy' equal to 'north bed': outcomes for 'copy' were labelled 'north bed' (cache hit) and pairing broke. Edit an input between prepare() and publish() of a fresh node → stale result accepted.

provisional_claims.summary: Studies: (1) later stages started every treatment from the previous stage's *control* checkpoint, discarding earlier care → each job continues from its own treatment's checkpoint. (2) stage decision was made as soon as one source had a complete cohort (worker completion order decided promotion) and a stage with no eligible source never recorded a failed decision → decision waits until all stage trials are terminal, then records promotion or failure.
provisional_claims.reproduction: python3 -m mosslight.studies db create examples/study.json; work with --offsets 3; report --stage 1: previously treatment outcomes' parent anchors all pointed at 'control' and stage-1 treatment gardens lacked stage-0 care; stage 0 report was saved after only 'north' finished (south still pending). With all controls failing, study stayed 'running' forever instead of failed.

provisional_claims.summary: Courier: (1) events recorded the packet-wide clock as causal context, so after receiving a projection of observation A a device's later edit/removal of observation B silently superseded B edits it never received → contexts are the per-observation record_clock. (2) checkpoint set every record context to the packet-wide clock (which after merging a projection covers unreceived events) → per-record coverage via record_clock. (3) merge kept the left writer's counter even when the right packet held later events of that writer → counter advanced to the merged clock to avoid event-id reuse. (4) from_garden default notebook hashed the entire save, so copies stopped sharing observations as soon as either changed → notebook identity from seed and dimensions.
provisional_claims.reproduction: desk puts a,b; field=merge(new_packet('field'),desk); desk puts b:'B2', a:'A2'; field2=merge(field, project(desk,['a'])); remove(field2,'b'); observations(merge(desk,field2)) previously dropped b (edit B2 never seen by field) → now b visible with B2; put(field3,'b',{'text':'B-field'}) previously overwrote B2 → now conflicted. from_garden on a copy after adding one note produced a different notebook namespace.

provisional_claims.summary: Courier CRDT fixes: (1) precedes() iterated only b's peers so an event from a writer absent in another event's context was treated as dominated (lost concurrent edits); (2) merge only compared record names when a writer dot was reused, now rejects any differing content; (3) _covered used the max context across ALL records instead of the event's own record, so sharing/compacting one observation dropped others; (4) project() kept contexts for unselected records, deleting unselected observations on merge; (5) observations() hid records when any concurrent head was a deletion (edit+delete must stay visible) and (6) casefolded values so 'Fern'/'fern' collapsed; (7) acknowledged() used max instead of min so a missing ack counted as progress; (8) put stored caller-owned values by reference.
provisional_claims.reproduction: a=new_packet('desk'); put(a,'n1',{'text':'Fern'}); b=merge(new_packet('field'),a); put(a,'n1',{'text':'Fern!'}); put(b,'n1',{'text':'fern'}); remove(...) etc. acknowledged({'desk':{'desk':3}},['desk','phone']) returned {'desk':3} (expected 0).

provisional_claims.summary: Several subsystem fixes: save_merge _logical_id mapped every record to ['base', id], so independently created records with the same number on both replicas collided/merged; now non-ancestral records are keyed by replica origin. history_exchange._common_bases truncated maximal common ancestors to one (maximal[:1]) breaking criss-cross (repeated round) reconciliation; now returns all bases for the recursive merge. workspace_catalog upgrade REINDEXed with the old v1 normalizer before installing the NFKC key (index stale after upgrade). field_calibration.estimate computed spread/covariance on raw timestamps (catastrophic cancellation for epoch-scale times); now uses centered offsets. irrigation_flow.allocate skipped residual reverse arcs so it was not a max flow; irrigation._identity merged states with equal census but different worlds (lost optimal schedules).

provisional_claims.summary: Engine/habitat/weather ecology fixes: (1) neighbor moisture averaged the partly-updated current grid instead of the previous day's snapshot (whole garden must grow together); (2) plant comfort used base shade instead of effective shade (shade cloth ignored for growth); (3) Hush penalized glowcaps (doc: glowcaps remain suited to Hush); (4) death age was hardcoded 105 instead of species lifespan (glowcap 75); (5) bare ground never recovered 1 nutrient/day; (6) phase() used %47 on a 48-day year; (7) effective_shade omitted the tile below a shade cloth (x,y+1); (8) rain barrels added water on clear days (doc: rainy days only); (9) stress rose at vitality 30 (doc: below 30); (10) worms ignored peat; (11) calendar_day season_day off by one; (12) longest dry spell counted drizzle days instead of rainless days; (13) next_weather included today instead of future days; (14) calendar showed one extra plan occurrence (gap//repeat <= remaining).

provisional_claims.summary: Workbench fixes: gardening.rectangle excluded the right column (inclusive rectangle); circle brush used diamond distance; transplant reset stress instead of carrying it to the destination; prune could push age below 0 / vitality above 100; craft only checked unit cost (balances could go negative for amount>1). Nursery: watering added 1 instead of restoring a 3-day supply; dry days still aged batches; plant_out only used 4 nutrients for the last seedling. Notebook: search end date exclusive (doc inclusive); tag filter matched substrings; specimens dropped vitality; complete_task ignored done=false (no reopen); overdue included today; task lists sorted by id not due date. Planning: plans could not start tomorrow (min day+2); bed names compared case-sensitively; rules read live values mutated by earlier rules instead of the day's conditions.

provisional_claims.summary: history_exchange reconciliation was order-dependent: reconcile(L,R) vs reconcile(R,L) interleaved concurrent insertions differently, so when both collaborators combined the same two publications (each naming its own first) the next round of reconciliation failed with an 'order-conflict'. _merge_events now merges the two publications in canonical (sorted id) order so equal combinations produce identical event order; together with returning all maximal common ancestors (criss-cross virtual base) later edits and reversions are retained.
provisional_claims.reproduction: A: note, B: task; A.reconcile(pa1,pb1), B.reconcile(pb1,pa1) -> event orders differed; each continues (A corrects away B's note, B adds a task); reconcile(pa2,pb2) raised order-conflict. Now merged: notes ['base','A note'], tasks ['B task'] in both argument orders.

provisional_claims.summary: Saves/analysis/server/CLI fixes: model.from_dict accepted empty cells with age or vitality (and→or); to_dict/from_dict shared journal dicts (not independent); state.validate accepted plants on stone, IDs equal to next_id, duplicate IDs across collections, and aliased caller data (now deep-copied). analysis.census averaged vitality over all tiles instead of living plants; diversity used log2 not ln; suitability ignored shade-cloth shelter; recommendations ignored empty_only; forecast omitted the final day when not a multiple of every; patches now listed largest first. commands.execute accepted extra top-level keys. exchange.transform_blueprint mirror/rotation off by one (width-x, height-y). server: publish set the world before saving (save failure lost the prior garden and polluted undo), undo stack kept the oldest 30, new edits did not clear redo, stale check accepted newer/boolean revisions, legacy imports without revision were renumbered, undo reused old revision numbers. CLI errors exited 1 (doc: 2); forecast same-path check compared raw strings.

provisional_claims.summary: (1) field_calibration.estimate fit raw readings, so repeated readings at one timestamp were weighted by count instead of using their average (FIELD_CALIBRATION.md) → readings grouped by timestamp and averaged before the least-squares fit. (2) HistoryStore.append did not return the new event identifier promised by HISTORY.md (and returned the branch head, which may be a later concurrent revision) → returns the snapshot of its own revision plus "event". (3) workspace_catalog treated an existing receipts table without a format row as current format (stale v1 index never rebuilt) and import_parcel crashed on format-1 receipts without locator / non-string ids → legacy detection + validated import. (4) model journal validation allowed 200 entries although saves retain 100 events.

provisional_claims.summary: (1) analysis.transect used `2*error > dy` instead of the standard Bresenham `>=`, so steep lines with exact half-tile ties chose a different path (e.g. (0,0)->(1,4) gave three tiles in column 0); now the canonical line through tile centers. (2) Watering a stone tile raised its moisture although stones stay at zero (engine.act water keeps stone at 0). (3) courier.recover accepted damaged slips with trailing garbage / non-string input (AttributeError) and did not bound the recovered note; now uses a zlib decompressobj requiring a complete stream with no unused data, and raises a clear ValueError for any damage. (4) model.from_dict accepted a boolean/float save version (True == 1) and World.index accepted booleans as coordinates.

provisional_claims.summary: Harvest did not start a new growth period: it only subtracted 5 days of age, so a well-established plant (e.g. moss age 20, vitality 90) could be harvested again immediately. WORKBENCH.md: "Harvesting takes vigor and starts a new growth period before the next harvest." Harvest now resets the plant's growth age so the species harvest age must be reached again (vigor cost unchanged).

Golden replay examples/hollow-actions.json still equals examples/lantern-hollow.json.

provisional_claims.summary: Robustness/contract fixes: campaigns.fork accepted negative/out-of-range offsets and branches (fork at checkpoint -1 shifted every parent event by +1) -> validates branch 0..n-1 and offset 0..days; studies.work_once only caught ValueError so any other trial exception left the job 'running' forever instead of a recorded, inspectable failure; server undo/redo could grow the opposite stack beyond the documented 30 edits; weather.next_weather raised near the 1,000,000-day calendar end instead of returning None and did not validate the window; planning/notebook creation functions returned entries sharing tile/tag lists with the stored garden (edits to returned data mutated the save); field calibration overwrote pond (100) and stone (0) moisture with the estimate.
provisional_claims.reproduction: store.fork(cid, 1, -1) previously created a child with events shifted; next_weather(w with day 999990,'clear',48) raised ValueError; n=add_note(w,'x',['a']); n['tags'].append('z') changed the stored note; calibrated_sources on a garden with a pond set pond moisture to the estimate.

provisional_claims.summary: Portability: the workspace CLIs (history export, history_exchange export/receive, courier merge/inspect, campaigns/ensembles/studies create/edit, irrigation save/load) read and wrote JSON parcels/saves with the platform locale encoding while emitting ensure_ascii=False Unicode. On non-UTF-8 installations (e.g. Windows cp1252) exported parcels/gardens with authored Unicode notes failed to write or could not be received on another machine ("received on a fresh installation"). All JSON file I/O in these modules now uses explicit UTF-8.
provisional_claims.reproduction: On a cp1252/latin-1 locale: history append a note containing '🌿', then `python -m mosslight.history db export BRANCH out.json` → UnicodeEncodeError; parcel written on a UTF-8 machine and received on a cp1252 machine → mojibake/JSON errors. After fix, export/receive round-trip the exact text (verified with LC_ALL=C run).

provisional_claims.summary: Input-validation and contract fixes: exchange.import_csv parsed survey numbers with int(), accepting ' 5', '+5' and non-ASCII digits as valid model values -> strict whole-number parsing (round-trip unchanged); workspace_catalog.search passed non-text labels into the SQLite key function (opaque sqlite error) -> ValueError; history_exchange.export and history.cherry_pick crashed with TypeError on non-string head/event ids -> clear ValueError; ensembles.create raised TypeError for a non-string treatment route -> ValueError; nursery: hydrated days now improve vigor for every living batch (doc: 'Hydrated days develop the batch and improve its vigor', batches need watering after they are ready), previously ready batches gained nothing.
provisional_claims.reproduction: import_csv with a row ' 0,0,...' was accepted; catalog.search(None) raised sqlite3 error; store.export(ch, heads=[{}]) raised TypeError; ensembles create with route ['x'] raised TypeError; a ready watered clover batch kept the same vitality across hydrated days.

provisional_claims.summary: Correction + hardening: reverted my earlier canonical-sorting change in history_exchange._merge_events because publication ids are random (nonce), which made reconcile results/conflicts depend on id order; reconcile is again deterministic in its left/right roles while keeping all maximal common ancestors for criss-cross merges. Added clear ValueErrors instead of crashes: courier.merge on non-object packets, campaigns.checkpoint with non-integer ordinal/offset (SQLite affinity could match '1'), ensembles revision lookups with non-integer revisions, history branch operations with blank/non-text labels (previously sqlite IntegrityError), history_exchange.receive on non-JSON/non-object parcels, irrigation.replay with a non-list schedule, studies.report with an out-of-range stage, gardening.tend_many with an unknown action (validated before copying), field_calibration.estimate on malformed readings or boolean timestamps.
